stanza: How can I convince you, it's me I don't like
And not be so indifferent to the look in your eyes
And I've always told lies for love

distant.line: We didn't talk for a while, he seemed more distant
distant.linePrev: Living his truth even if it meant see a surgeon
distant.lineNext: Wasn't comfortable around me, everything was offensive

resistant.line: In the face to make them more resistant
stanza: If I had been God, I would have rearranged the veins
In the face to make them more resistant
To alcohol and less prone to aging
I would have sired many sons and I would not have suffered
The Romans to kill even one of them
If I had been God with my staff and my rod
If I had been given the nod
I believe I could have done a better job
